topic: Bayes' Theorem and Independence: Unlocking Probability

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: Conditional Probability
lecture_lines: We narrow down possibilities with new information.
animations: Draw a large white rectangle as sample space S #FFFFFF.
Color region A within S in light blue #3399FF.
Color region B within S in light green #33FF33.

sections.title: Defining Independence
lecture_lines: Independent events do not influence each other.
Outcome A doesn't change probability of B.
Like flipping coins and rolling dice.
animations: Display formula P(A|B) = P(A and B) / P(B) in white #FFFFFF.
Circle intersection (A and B) with a yellow stroke #FFFF00 and overlay the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg].
Dim the area outside (A and B) to dark grey #333333.

sections.title: The Core: Bayes' Theorem
lecture_lines: Bayes' Theorem bridges priors and new evidence.
Divide by P(E) to normalize results.
It transforms beliefs into precise updates.
Medical tests illustrate this probability shift.
animations: Write P(H|E) = [P(E|H) * P(H)] / P(E) in bold white #FFFFFF.
Highlight numerator P(E|H) in #FF00FF and P(H) in #FF9900 alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stethoscope.svg].
Highlight denominator P(E) in #00FFFF as the background.
Slide the terms to show the posterior P(H|E).
Display text "Posterior reflects the updated belief" in light cyan #E0FFFF accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/syringe.svg].

sections.title: Application: The Detective Robot
lecture_lines: Robots use Bayes to localize themselves.
A more accurate position is calculated.
Probability is a dynamic estimation process.
animations: Create a 5x5 grid of potential positions in white #FFFFFF.
Animate a Gaussian distribution fading over the grid #FFFF00.
Show [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg] range pulse over the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg]'s predicted area.
Focus on the most likely cell in bright gold #FFD700.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
lecture_lines: Bayes' Theorem uses information to transform.
Both frame how we perceive uncertainty.
animations: Show a diagram comparing Independent vs Conditional paths #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Overlay Bayes' formula block next to the Conditional path #FFFFFF.
Flash all core concepts with a soft golden glow #FFD700.
